summary: Changelog only, no code or configuration change. v0.27.0 was released from f818efa with agent 0.29.0, matching the changelog at that tag; the row now links the release and names agent 0.29.0 again. Agent 0.29.1 (same code, first manifest signed with the rotated key) becomes the new row v0.27.1. The development-tooling heading records that the pinning item shipped in v0.26.1 and the rest in v0.27.0.

findings.resolution: Published tag left unchanged; the changelog follows the release and v0.27.1 carries agent 0.29.1.
